meta.title: {brand} · Lost & found licence plates in Thailand
meta.description: Lost a licence plate in a flood, or found one? Post it here and we match plate numbers straight away. Free, no ads.

language.switchToLabel: เปลี่ยนเป็นภาษาไทย

home.title: Lost a plate in the flood? Let's get it home.
home.lead: People who lost a plate register the number. People who found one send a photo. We match them straight away so you can get in touch.
home.actionsLabel: What would you like to do?

lost.title: I lost a plate
lost.hint: Register your plate. It’s matched the moment someone finds it.

found.title: I found a plate
found.hint: Take a photo of it and we'll help find the owner.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Register a lost plate, or photograph one you found
how.step3: You contact each other to arrange the handover

dormant.title: We're closed for now
dormant.body: We'll reopen when floods return. Stay safe.

footer.nonCommercial: No ads. Not for profit in any way.
footer.privacy: No GPS tracking. Posts are deleted automatically when they expire.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the post has been removed.

plate.instructions: Type the plate in one go, e.g. กค7812 or 1กข 1234, then tap to choose the province.
plate.provinceNone: No province matches. Try another spelling.
plate.wildcardButtonLabel: Add ? for a character you can't read
plate.wildcardHint: Can't read a character? Put ? in its place.
plate.unverifiedHint: This doesn't look like a standard plate. It may have a typo; please check it.

errors.invalid: Something isn't right. Please check and try again.
errors.plate_number_required: Enter the number. Use ? for digits you can't read.
errors.province_invalid: Choose a province from the list.
errors.line_id_invalid: LINE IDs have 4–20 characters: letters, digits, . - or _
errors.phone_invalid: Enter a 9–10 digit Thai number, e.g. 0812345678
errors.email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right.
errors.contact_required: Add at least one way to contact you.
errors.pin_weak: That PIN is too easy to guess. Try another.
errors.consent_required: Please read and agree before sending.
errors.text_url: Links aren't allowed here, to protect people from scams.
errors.text_id_number: Please don't enter an ID card number.
errors.text_account_number: Bank or PromptPay numbers aren't allowed here, to protect people from scams.
errors.district_invalid: Just the district name, please. No house numbers.
errors.turnstile_required: Please wait for the bot check to finish, then send again.

api.turnstile_failed: The bot check failed. Please send again.
api.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
api.dormant: We're not accepting posts right now.
api.consent_outdated: Our terms have changed. Please reload the page.
api.upload_token_invalid: The upload window has expired. Please start again.
api.batch_full: You can send up to 20 plates at a time.
api.image_too_small: The plate image is too small. Draw a bigger box.
api.image_type: This file isn't a supported image.
api.image_unreadable: We couldn't open this image. Try another one.
api.network: Can't connect. Check your signal and try again.
api.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
api.not_found: We couldn't find this post. It may have been removed.

consent.label: I agree that my plate number and contact details are stored to match plates, and that the other person sees my contact details when there's a match. Everything is deleted automatically within 60 days.

contact.title: How to reach you
contact.intro: Only shown to the other person when there's a match. Add at least one.
contact.showEmail: Let the other person see this email too

pin.title: Set a PIN
pin.intro: Use the PIN with your plate number to edit or delete your post from another device.
pin.label: 4–6 digit PIN
pin.hint: Keep it safe. We can't see or recover your PIN.

lost.title: I lost a plate
lost.plateIntro: Enter the number of the lost plate. We'll check right away whether someone has found it.
lost.foundAlreadyBody: Contact the finder right from the card below. Compare the photo with your plate first.
lost.notFoundYet: Nobody has found this plate yet. Register a watch and it will be matched automatically when someone does.
lost.doneTitle: Your watch is set. It will be matched automatically when someone finds this plate.
lost.doneManage: Check for matches under “My posts” on this device, and keep your PIN: you’ll need it with your plate number to delete or edit the post.
lost.doneMatches: Someone may have found your plate
lost.alsoWatch: Also register a watch, in case more turn up

found.title: I found a plate
found.intro: Take a photo of the plates you found and we'll help find their owners. One photo can contain several plates.
found.privacyNote: Only the cropped plate images are sent, never the full photo, and location data is removed.
found.drawHint: Drag a box around one plate at a time. Let go and it is cut out and read automatically.
found.useWhole: Use the whole photo (one plate only)
found.photoError: We couldn't open this photo. Try another one.
found.noPlatesYet: No plates yet. Take or choose a photo first.
found.tooMany: You can send up to {max} plates at a time.
found.needPlates: Add at least one plate first.
found.policeNoteHint: e.g. Mueang Chiang Mai Police Station
found.legalNote: Finders should return plates to their owners or hand them to the police.
found.districtHint: Just the district, no address. The owner sees it after asking for your contact details.
found.submit: Send {count, plural, one {# plate} other {# plates}}
found.doneBody: We'll match these plates with people looking for them, and keep matching as new lost plates are registered.
found.ownerLooking: The owner is looking for it!
found.ownerLookingBody: This plate matches a lost plate that someone registered.
found.reviewNote: This plate will be shown after a moderator checks it.
found.doneManage: Check for matches under “My posts” on this device, and keep your PIN: you’ll need it with a plate number to delete or edit your posts.

lostCheck.checking: Checking whether anyone is looking for this plate…
lostCheck.exactTitle: Someone is looking for this plate!
lostCheck.exactBody: Finish posting (step 2) and the owner will see that you found it and can contact you.
lostCheck.nearTitle: Someone is looking for a similar plate
lostCheck.nearBody: Check the letters, number and province against the real plate, then post. The owner will be shown the match.
lostCheck.none: No one has reported this plate lost yet. Post it anyway: if the owner reports it later, they are matched automatically.

search.title: Search a plate number
search.intro: Search plates that people have found.
search.nearHint: The number may differ slightly. Compare it with the photo.
search.none: Nobody has found this plate yet
search.noneBody: Register your lost plate and it will be matched automatically when someone finds it.

match.title: Match details
match.nearBody: The numbers are close. Compare the photo to make sure it's your plate.
match.atPolice: The plate is at a police station
match.finderBody: Contact the owner to arrange the handover. Send a photo of the plate next to a paper with the owner’s name so they can trust you.

reveal.intro: To protect yourself from scams, always:
reveal.tip1: Never transfer money before you have the plate back.
reveal.tip2: Ask the finder for a photo of the plate next to a paper with your name on it, to prove they have it.
reveal.tip3: At the handover, check that the name and plate number match the registration book and ID card.
reveal.tip4: Meet in a public place or at a police station.
reveal.acknowledge: I've read this and will follow it
reveal.reminder: Never transfer money before you have your plate back.

post.title: Found plate
post.atPolice: The plate is at a police station
post.compare: Compare the photo with your plate before getting in touch.

note.label: Note
note.lostHint: e.g. front or rear plate, marks on the plate, where it was lost
note.foundHint: e.g. both front and rear plates, marks, where you found them
note.rule: No links, bank account or ID card numbers.
note.lostShownTo: The finder sees this note when there is a match.
note.foundShownTo: The owner sees this note after asking for your contact details.

myPosts.title: My posts
myPosts.intro: Posts made on this device, with their matches.
myPosts.empty: No posts on this device yet
myPosts.emptyBody: Posts you create on this device will appear here.
myPosts.noMatches: No match yet. It will be matched automatically when a matching post appears.
myPosts.needsReview: Waiting for a moderator before it’s shown
myPosts.otherDevices: Posts from other devices don’t show here.

ocr.loading: Loading the automatic plate reader {percent}% (about 5 MB the first time)
ocr.scanning: Looking for plates in the photo…
ocr.found: {count, plural, one {Found # plate} other {Found # plates}}. Check the cards below; drag a box around any plate that was missed.
ocr.none: No plates found automatically. Drag a box around each plate yourself.
ocr.failed: Automatic reading didn't work. Drag a box and type the plate yourself.
ocr.read: Read automatically. Please check it before sending.
ocr.lowConfidence: Not very sure about this one. Check every character; unreadable ones show as ?.
ocr.unread: Couldn't read this plate. Please type it yourself.
